title: Gus and the Volcano

pages.scene: A cheerful cartoon character named Gus standing in front of a large smoking volcano, looking excited and adventurous. Bright colors, child-friendly style.
Gus sitting on a gray rock in a grassy field, looking curious. A large hill (volcano) visible in the background. Simple cartoon style.
Gus looking up at a big hill with wonder. The hill has smoke coming from the top. Gus points excitedly.
Gus starting to climb the hill, determined expression, one foot on the slope. Speech bubble feeling.
Gus climbing higher and higher up the volcano slope. Motion lines showing upward movement. Energetic pose.
Gus reaching the top of the volcano, arms raised in triumph. Standing on the crater rim.
Gus peering down into a large dark pit/crater. His eyes are wide with curiosity. Steam rising.
View inside the volcano crater showing bright red and orange lava bubbling. Dramatic and exciting but not scary.
Gus with huge excited eyes and open mouth, amazed at what he sees. Stars and excitement marks around him.
The volcano making sounds - steam hissing, smoke puffing, bubbles popping. Onomatopoeia visual effects.
The red magma/lava rising and getting bigger inside the crater. Gus looking concerned.
Gus feeling the heat, wiping his brow. Heat waves visible. The lava glowing bright orange-red.
Gus turning to run, looking back at the volcano. Urgent expression. Starting to move fast.
Gus running down the volcano slope at full speed. Legs moving fast, determined face.
Gus still running, getting closer to safety. The volcano smoking behind him in the distance.

pages.text: Gus got back to his rock.
pages.scene: Gus back at his original rock, safe and sound. Looking relieved and happy. Volcano in background.
Gus shaking his head 'no' but smiling - he's not done adventuring! Playful expression.
Gus striking a proud pose, chest puffed out. He accomplished his goal!
Gus telling his story excitedly, gesturing toward the volcano in the background. Happy and proud.
Gus celebrating with arms raised, big smile. Stars and celebration marks. The volcano peaceful in background.
Final scene: Gus waving goodbye, volcano behind him. 'The End' feeling. Warm sunset colors.

reference_prompt:
A 9-panel reference sheet for children's book illustration style.
Style: Playful watercolor illustration, expressive characters, vibrant colors, child-friendly art style
Mood: energetic, fun, adventurous

The 9 panels arranged in a 3x3 grid showing:
Panel 1: Gus and the Volcano
Panel 2: Words to Know
Panel 3: Gus sat on a rock.
Panel 4: Gus saw the big hill.
Panel 5: "I can go up!" said Gus.
Panel 6: Up, up, up!
Panel 7: Gus got to the top.
Panel 8: Gus saw a big pit.
Panel 9: Red! Hot! Lava!

Consistent art style across all panels, suitable for children's picture book illustration. Each panel is a square vignette showing a key moment or character.

IMPORTANT: Minimize text in panels. Focus on visual style, characters, colors, and mood. No title text.

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover. Ask: What is Gus looking at? What do you know about volcanoes? This book practices CVC words like 'hot', 'got', 'top', and 'run'.
parent_tips.during_reading: Point out the CVC words: sat, got, top, pit, hot, pop, run. Help your child blend the sounds. Use an excited voice for the action words!
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: Was it safe for Gus to climb the volcano? What did he see? Would you want to see a volcano?

comprehension_questions.question: Where did Gus sit at the beginning?
What did Gus see at the top?
What sounds did the volcano make?
What did Gus do when the magma got big?
How did Gus feel at the end?
comprehension_questions.answer: Excited and proud - Wow! Wow! Wow!

summary: Gus the adventurer climbs a big hill that turns out to be a volcano! He sees the hot lava and has to run when it starts to bubble. A fun CVC word adventure about curiosity and excitement.
